title: Method for communication between ai/ml capable clients during federated learning

pse.problem: The limitation lies in the lack of an efficient communication method between devices with AI/ML capability for federated learning in 5G networks, causing deficiencies in computer technology.
pse.solution_function: The system envelopes federated learning messages with a control message format containing fields indicating message identifier, size, type, and body. The controlled AI/ML federated learning allows the server to manage multiple devices, implement federated portions of the learning, and receive reports from each device.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of memory storing computer program code and a processor that accesses and operates according to the code.
pse.solution_implementation: The system implements AI/ML federated learning in rounds, with each round involving iterations between the server and multiple devices. The federated learning begins simultaneously at all devices, and the body of the message indicates device eligibility, synchronization, model evaluation, update, and error information.
pse.effect: The system improves communication efficiency during AI/ML federated learning in 5G networks, enabling parallel execution for increased speedup and resource optimization
